contents.name: pyproject.toml
contents.content:
[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools==75.8.0"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "private-rag-v1"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Implementation of the standalone private RAG v1 specification"
requires-python = ">=3.11,<3.12"
dependencies = [
  "cryptography==49.0.0", "fastapi==0.115.12", "uvicorn==0.34.2",
  "psycopg[binary]==3.2.9", "PyYAML==6.0.2", "httpx==0.28.1", "keyring==25.6.0", "tokenizers==0.21.4",
]

[project.scripts]
private-rag = "private_rag.cli:main"

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
include = ["private_rag*"]

[tool.setuptools.package-data]
private_rag = ["schema/*.sql"]

content.formatter: clang-format 20.1.8 via uv tool run, not a runtime dependency
content.build_parallelism_scope: per CMake build invocation; compiler work is separate from model execution

content.scope: Device open, CUDA initialization and tiny GPU arithmetic only
Host CUDA UVM recovery and device readiness, not full model or R2 success
content.authorization: User authorized CUDA repair; administrator credential supplied interactively and not persisted in project files.

attempts.reason: KDE service stop job canceled by reactivation

after.scope: Device open, CUDA initialization and tiny GPU arithmetic only

content.display_policy: Keep existing NVIDIA DP external display per user reply; KWin primary renderer and OBS OpenGL renderer already use AMD Renoir.

content.scope: Current full-model execution resource policy, not protocol validation
content.R2_current_crypto_backend: Pinned SEAL/SCI CPU primitives; CUDA references do not provide private GPU computation
content.native_gate: private_model_gpu_backend_available() is false, independently required before reading inputs, opening protocol channels or constructing SecureOps

content.scope: current builds and closed gate only
actual production-shaped build and closed gate, no model run
fresh development build, execution registration and binary-copy checks; no model execution

boundary: Only public definitions and evidence are bundled; runtime weights and libraries remain separate. No full R2 success or formal acceptance claim.
